One marked holding, no recorded fills—and a failed research run

Paper trading · 2026-11-09T17:00:44.608928-05:00

This report covers records through 2026-11-09 22:00:44 UTC (5:00:44 p.m. ET). The paper account snapshot shows $2,000 cash and equity. Of the three books, only mean-reversion has a listed holding: 0.053191 MU shares, marked at $40.36 using a midpoint observed at 21:29:28 UTC (4:29:28 p.m. ET). That older snapshot may precede later activity and is not a live after-hours price. The other two books report $2,000 cash and equity. The day's listed research-planner run failed, so it is not evidence of deliberate waiting. No proposals, risk outcomes, or fills for today are present in the supplied records.

Today's lesson: A failed run is not a quiet decision

A failed run is not the same as a decision to wait. Today's research-planner run failed at 20:22 UTC, and the supplied records contain no completed proposal, deterministic risk approval or rejection, submitted order, or fill for the day. A submitted order, if one existed, would still not prove a fill.

The latest separate paper performance record is older, from November 6, when it also showed $2,000 equity and zero P&L; that does not establish today's return. MU — mean-reversion

The mean-reversion book holds 0.053191 MU shares at an average purchase price of $939.88 per share. Its observed bid/ask midpoint was $758.69 at 2026-11-09 21:29:28 UTC (4:29:28 p.m. ET), giving a marked value of $40.36 and unrealized P&L of -$9.64. For example, 0.053191 × $758.69 is about $40.36; the position's purchase basis is about $50.00. These book gains exclude fees. The price is a recorded snapshot, not a live after-hours price, and the null current_price does not invalidate the supplied observed_price. No current investment thesis or research is supplied, and no counterargument to one is recorded. The observed price below the average purchase price is the clearest adverse figure; the snapshot's timing is a valuation limitation, not an established cause of the decline.

How to read the book mark

The mean-reversion book's $1,950.01 cash plus its $40.36 MU mark gives $1,990.36 marked equity. Its roughly $9.64 gap below the $2,000 starting cash matches the listed unrealized loss; realized P&L is $0. This is a book mark combining cutoff cash with the holding's earlier price observation. The books' purchase prices exclude fees.

Paper account timing

The recorded paper account snapshot is from 22:00:44 UTC. A separate paper performance record from November 6 showed $2,000 equity and zero P&L, but that older record does not establish today's return. Missing or older performance figures should not be treated as today's result.

What to watch next

Watch for a completed run and records that distinguish proposals, deterministic risk outcomes, submitted orders, and actual fills. For the MU holding, compare any later recorded observation with this 21:29:28 UTC snapshot; the current report has no later admitted price.

Snapshot: A recorded price at a particular time. It may be older than the report cutoff and is not necessarily live or the official closing price.

Unrealized P&L: A position's marked value minus its purchase basis, before it is realized by a sale. The book's reported gain or loss excludes fees.

Marked equity: Cash plus the value assigned to holdings using their recorded price snapshots. It is an estimate, not necessarily live account equity.

Data timing and limitations

Prices come from recorded snapshots, not a guaranteed closing-price feed.
Paper account holdings use the latest recorded snapshot, which may precede fills.
Book marks use observed bid/ask midpoints at price_as_of, not guaranteed live prices. Without an admitted quote the value remains unknown; book gains exclude fees.
Work starting after the cutoff is outside this report. Failures remain labelled.
